children: FORT Robotics plans to merge with Newbury Street II Acquisition Corp.

in a SPAC deal expected to close this quarter. The transaction values the combined company at a $556.6M pro forma enterprise value, with a $500M pre-money equity valuation. Following completion, it expects to trade on Nasdaq as FORT Robotics Holdings under FROB.

The Philadelphia-based robotics safety business was established in 2018. The company's “Trust Layer” provides safety infrastructure designed to let autonomous machines from different manufacturers operate alongside people. Earlier this year, it acquired Mapless AI, adding remote human control and onboard active-safety capabilities. The company reports more than 19.5K deployed units serving over 600 customers, including Google DeepMind

"Automation and autonomy are expanding across nearly every major industry, creating a significant need for solutions that make intelligent machines safe, secure, and reliable," stated FORT Robotics CEO Samuel Reeves.

Key backers include Tiger Global, Mark Cuban Companies, Prologis Ventures, and Five Eleven Partners. Tiger Global led FORT’s Series B financing in 2022. This week, FORT announced approximately $20M in additional commitments. FORT said total committed capital connected with the proposed transaction now exceeds $50M.

Looking ahead, FORT plans to expand its workforce and operating capacity, pursue customers in warehousing, defense, and construction, and develop safety-intelligence, monitoring, and cybersecurity software. It also intends to expand international sales and distribution partnerships and make targeted acquisitions.

title: Mark Cuban-backed FORT Robotics secures more funding ahead of public debut
